title: Tunisian Galette
description: A sweet and flaky pastry galette filled with a nutty Tunisian filling.
instructions: Roll out the flaky pastry on a lightly floured surface.
Transfer the pastry to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Mix the chopped almonds, honey, orange blossom water, tunisian spice blend, and confectioners' sugar in a bowl.
Spread the nutty mixture evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the edges of the pastry up over the filling to form a crust.
Dot the top of the galette with the unsalted butter.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
